note: Evidence could not be established either way — this is NOT a confirmation and NOT a denial. ImportKey was checked under two slug variants (omega-crankshaft, omega-crankshafts); both are JavaScript shells that render zero rows without a paid login, so the 'shipments available' wording is a template claim, not a record. Second sources volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to direct fetch. The web_search tool was non-functional for the entire session (connection refused), so no independent page could be discovered. Consequently: no export record with date/destination/HS/B-L number was found, and no domestic supply evidence was found — but absence here reflects tool failure, not a verified absence of shipments. Declared HS 848330 (bearing housings/plain shaft bearings) is inconsistent with a crankshaft product line (crankshafts sit in 8483.10), which is worth flagging for the HS correction step, though per project rules HS mismatch is not grounds for rejection. No revenue or export-volume figures are asserted: both null, not public in anything retrieved. Recommended next step: re-run once search is restored, and query Volza/Eximpedia via an authenticated or non-blocked route before assigning any shipment verdict.
